title: A quiver presentation of the type D arc algebras and intrinsic formality of $\mathbb{D}_4$
summary: We construct a presentation of the Khovanov arc algebras of type $D$ by a quiver with quadratic relations. As an application, we use this presentation and the Koszul dual to compute some Hochschild cohomology groups of $\mathbb{D}_4$, and show that $\mathbb{D}_4$ is intrinsically formal, that is, it admits no non-trivial $A_\infty$-deformations.
